description: Survey Dataset on Solar Energy, Electricity Access, and Governance in Yemen, published by Clausen, Maria-Louise, provides anonymized telephone-survey responses on electricity, solar-energy use and governance in Yemen. Coverage: 1,000 respondents in seven Yemeni governorates, surveyed in August 2025; this is not a census. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked cc-by-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: Survey perceptions and self-reported access are not direct engineering measurements; sampling representativeness is not established from the deposit. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
